results.name: L1 k_c = 3+2sqrt2 <=> sinh2K = 1 <=> k_O = 1 (m = 1); 3-2sqrt2 is K = -K_c
L2a Onsager integral = (1 + k_O) x pendulum quarter period at m = k_O^2 (Landen), both sides of k_c
L2b dial gas torus (z = k^-2) matches Onsager-via-pendulum <ss>: within 1e-3 at L=6 for k = 2, 10, 20; closing in at k = 3 (nearer k_c)
L3a ordered side: Yang M^8 = 1 - m; Kramers-Wannier dual sends m -> 1/m (swinging <-> over the top)
L3b Onsager k1 = 2 sqrt(k_O)/(1+k_O) is the same at k_O and 1/k_O (one integral serves both phases)
L4 couplings sinh2K1 = -i sn(iu, k_O), sinh2K2 = same at K'-u: product 1/k_O; equal (isotropic) at u = K'/2; tan at k_c
L5 dial gas Fisher zeros close in on |k_O| = 1 (|m| = 1, the separatrix in complex energy) as L grows, well inside random scatter
results.detail: L=4: median ||k_O|-1| 0.133 vs random 0.325 (16 zeros); L=5: median ||k_O|-1| 0.100 vs random 0.324 (20 zeros); L=6: median ||k_O|-1| 0.086 vs random 0.309 (36 zeros)
